notes.title: New Update Available Now
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I've just released a new update for the game.

It mostly fixes issues with 4k resolutions and ultrawide aspect ratios. And it also fixed some issue with the 4:3 option from the menu. Also brought the game up to the newest Unity 6 version.

I hope this helps anyone who had issues running the game correctly.

Have Fun!

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Hello there,

I've just released another update for the game bringing it up to 64 bit and limiting the FPS to 60.
Also fixed the bug where you could get more than the maximum score and miss the achievement.

Cheers,
 Tim

notes.title: Update 1.07 with updated graphics released!
notes.notes:
A new update for Curse of the Old Gods has been released!


Some of you had a hard time with the bright and unusual color palette of blues and purples. The new update introduces the option to switch to a vintage black and white movie art-style. (You can find the option under settings "Bright Colors" in the smartphone in your inventory)

Additionally you can now save up to 15 different save games... your best chance to achieve all the different endings! 

Change Log:
-Introducing new optional art-style for the game
-Added save slot system for up to 15 save games
-Fixed bugs regarding aspec ratios and fullscreen switches
-Fixed compatibility issues
-Upgraded to newest Unity version

notes.title: Version 1.05 released!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31251389/2fdcb81c396e2217b23a4157a3e10b1c16a1dcb6.png

Hello everyone,

we've just released version 1.05 of the game with a whole bunch of changes and improvements. Below you will find the change log with everything you need to know. Enjoy! 

Improvements:
-You can now right-click to show interactable objects in the scene.
-Added two new secret achievements. Can you unlock them?
-Added several new interactions in the game and more comments from Agent Moreton.
-Added an animation to the notification icon to be more visible.
-Added some hints for the harder puzzles.
-Reduced the music volume for some songs.

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed a bug where hints stayed on the screen when an object was picked up.
-Fixed a bug where text and predestinations overlapped with other text boxes.
-Fixed several typos and improved overall text quality.
-Additional small fixes here and there.
